column1: # Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition 3.0.1 (SDK 21.4.4 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), Monolith's engine, NVN2 with DLSS).
# The Switch 1 game is its own profile (0100E95004038000). See README.md for the measured bring-up and validation status.
# main imports nothing from subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_DLSS) or subsdk2 (C / libc) that the host does not supply (dm/games/profile_guess.py modules)
# The NPDM declares 96 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on, and main never sets a heap. nninitStartup sets up two 60 GB address regions; the second
# (0xf00000000, asked by main+0xb7a540) found its limit 0 in a 64 GB alias region: a null first arena and a crash in memset at sdk+0x798ce8. 128 GB holds both, as
# Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition's Switch 2 Edition
# Horizon's physical-pool limit: the engine probes capacity by mapping until a map fails; without it the probe mapped all 60 GB of its address region and the arena
# that follows was null (memset at sdk+0x798ce8 from main+0xb7a650)
